discovery-weak-signals.name: Strategic vertical integration
discovery-weak-signals.basis: Iridium would add spectrum, an operating network and service revenue to Rocket Lab's launch, spacecraft and payload stack.

discovery-weak-signals.name: National-security bottleneck exposure
discovery-weak-signals.basis: Recent Space Force awards span sensing, launch and communications, indicating demand for vertically integrated sovereign space capability.

discovery-weak-signals.name: Capital intensity / dilution
discovery-weak-signals.basis: The completed ATM issued 29.3 million shares and raised $1.944 billion gross, making equity dilution a material cost of the expansion strategy.

discovery-weak-signals.name: Government procurement and strategic relevance
discovery-weak-signals.basis: Multiple 2026 Space Force awards span missile-defense test launch, sensing satellites, optical communications and mission operations.

discovery-weak-signals.name: Vertical integration
discovery-weak-signals.basis: SB-AMTI combines spacecraft development, Neutron launch and operations, directly testing Rocket Lab's end-to-end model.

discovery-weak-signals.name: Launch execution
discovery-weak-signals.basis: Electron reached 16 launches in 2026 by September 11 and 95 missions overall, providing operating cadence evidence independent of Neutron.

discovery-weak-signals.name: Neutron program dependency
discovery-weak-signals.basis: Material future contract value and medium-lift expansion depend on Neutron reaching operational readiness on schedule and at acceptable economics.

expectations-execution.name: Financing execution
expectations-execution.basis: The equity funding was completed and the bridge commitment terminated, reducing financing uncertainty relative to the June announcement.

expectations-execution.name: Shareholder dilution
expectations-execution.basis: 29.3 million newly issued shares funded a substantial portion of the transaction consideration.

expectations-execution.name: Transaction execution
expectations-execution.basis: Funding is substantially de-risked, but closing, regulatory approval and integration remain ahead.

expectations-execution.name: Expectation risk
expectations-execution.basis: The strategic scope is unusually large relative to Rocket Lab's historical business; strong narrative optionality must be separated from realized post-close cash-flow and synergy evidence.

expectations-execution.name: Execution versus narrative
expectations-execution.basis: Electron cadence and diversified government awards substantiate the platform narrative, but Neutron remains a major uncompleted execution step.

expectations-execution.name: Expectation burden
expectations-execution.basis: Large integrated awards create increasingly concrete milestones against which spacecraft production, launch readiness and operations will be judged.

expectations-execution.name: Contract diversification
expectations-execution.basis: Awards span HASTE, satellite manufacture, sensing, optical communications, mission operations and future Neutron launch rather than one product line.

expectations-execution.name: Security-level valuation attractiveness
expectations-execution.basis: No canonical live valuation or entry input is part of this Scout packet; no price-based recommendation is promoted.

thesisQuality.basis: Record revenue/backlog and expanding integrated-space scope support the thesis.

financialOperatingMomentum.basis: Record $234M Q2 revenue, +62% YoY, and $2.36B backlog, +137% YoY.

marketValuationOpportunity.basis: ~$40.59B market cap and ~52.85x sales embed substantial expectations.

catalystScore.basis: 90+ launch backlog, Neutron and major new contract flow provide multiple catalysts.

governancePower.basis: Founder-led execution is strong but aggressive acquisition/capital strategy adds governance risk.

alignment2036.basis: Launch, spacecraft and communications directly align with orbital infrastructure expansion.

crossDivisionLeverage.basis: Launch and space systems create explicit vertical integration.

bottleneckControl.basis: Integrated launch and spacecraft capability controls multiple scarce execution steps.

scenarioRobustness.basis: Diversified demand is offset by development and acquisition execution sensitivity.

substitutionResilience.basis: Flight heritage and integration create switching friction with credible substitutes remaining.

supplyChainResilience.basis: Vertical integration improves control but aerospace supply chains remain demanding.

pricingPower.basis: Backlog growth and contract wins support value capture without proving monopoly pricing.

riskEvidence.basis: Valuation, losses, dilution and major-program execution are material risks.

dataConfidenceEvidence.basis: Current issuer operating evidence plus independent current market data support reproducible scoring.

scoreRecord.thesis: Rocket Lab is evolving from launch provider into an integrated space infrastructure platform spanning launch, spacecraft and communications, with rapid revenue and backlog growth.
scoreRecord.keyRisk: The market valuation discounts substantial future success while losses, dilution, Neutron execution and acquisition integration remain material.
scoreRecord.nextCatalyst: Q3 2026 revenue/backlog conversion and Neutron/Iridium execution milestones.

contradictions.resolution: Keep Electron/space-systems operating evidence analytically separate from Neutron-dependent future value; do not use current Electron cadence as proof that Neutron risk is resolved.

contradictions.resolution: Treat awards/bookings as demand evidence; require separate technical execution, financial realization and valuation evidence for those distinct questions.
